sentences.text: Writ petition (civil) praying inter alia that in the circumstances  stated in the affidavit filed along with the WP(C) the High Court be  pleased to direct not to take any coercive steps against the petitioner  under the Food Safety and Standard Act pending consideration of the writ  petition.

This petition coming on for admission upon perusing the petition and  the affidavit filed in support of WP(C) and upon hearing the arguments of  M/S. S.SUJIN, NITA.N.S., T.N.GIRIJA, N.BHARAT, B.BILWIN, KEERTHI M., POOJA  SURENDRAN
Advocates for the petitioners, the court passed the following:
ORDER Government Pleader will get instructions.
Coercive steps against the petitioner shall be deferred for a period of two weeks.
/True Copy/ Assistant Registrar Kairali Ice Plant vs The Assistant Commissioner on 25 August, 2023
